hypotheses.J0_downstream_fingerprint_validates: A router from singleton attention-response norms and pairwise cosines reaches median fidelity >=0.95 and 10th percentile >=0.80 on grouped FineWeb CV and frozen WikiText.
hypotheses.J1_fingerprint_beats_raw_state: It improves 10th-percentile fidelity by at least 0.05 over the selected raw-state router on both FineWeb CV and WikiText.
hypotheses.J2_fingerprint_is_used: Site-shuffling the WikiText fingerprints reduces 10th-percentile fidelity by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.J3_pairwise_downstream_geometry_is_insuf: The unshuffled fingerprint router remains below 0.80 at the 10th percentile on either corpus.
